dct_description_sm: Eight skin and blubber biopsies of killer whales (Orcinus orca) in Milne Inlet and Tremblay Sound (7241′57″N 07757′33″W) were collected during several encounters with 15-20+ animals in 2013. This fieldwork was part of an ongoing study of killer whales in the Eastern Canadian Arctic using satellite telemetry, biopsy, and photo identification to learn more about killer whale distribution and migration, diet, social structure, and population size.
dct_title_s: Killer whale (Orcinus orca) skin and blubber biopsies, Milne Inlet, Nunavut, 2013 (NGMP ID EC05)
